82100f ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT AGREEMENT made as of this 30th day of December, 2003 (this“Agreement"), between OLYMPIC FUNDING LLC,a New York limited liability company,having an address at 430 West Broadway, New York, New York 10012 ("Seller") and FIFTH @ 42ND LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at 565 Fifth Avenue,New York, New York 10017("Developer"). RECITALS: A. Seller is the owner of certain land known by the street address 1-3 East 42nd Street, a/k/a 4 East 43rd Street, New York, New York, also known as Tax Lot 6 in Block 1277 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York, more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part hereof, together with theimprovements with any future additions and/or replacements thereof being herein referred to as “Seller's Building," and Seller's Land and Seller's Building being herein referred to as “Seller's Property"). B. Developer is the owner of certain lands adjacent to Seller's Land, known by the street addresses 503 Fifth Avenue, 505 Fifth Avenue and 507 Fifth Avenue, New York, New York, also known as Tax Lots 1, 2 and 4 respectively in Block 1277 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York, more particularly described in Schedule B annexed 10 of theZoningResolution of the City of NewYork,effectiveDecember15,1961(as amended to the date hereof, the“Zoning Resolution") appurtenant to those certain other parcels of land contiguous therewithknownasandbythestreetaddress509FifthAvenue,NewYork,New York and being Lot 72 in Block 1277as shown on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork (the improvements, together with any future replacements thereof or additions thereto whether made by Developer or Developer's successors or assigns, being herein referred to collectively as "“Developer's Existing Building"). C. Developer may renovate Developer's Existing Building or construct a new building or buildings and improvements upon all or a portion of Developer's Land (said new or renovated building or buildings and improvements, together with any further replacements thereof or additions thereto whether made by Developer or Developer's successors or assigns, being herein referred to collectively as “Developer's Proposed Building” and Developer's Land, Developer's Existing Building and Developer's Proposed Building being herein referred to collectively as"Developer'sProperty"). D. Seller and Developer wish to merge Developer's Property and Seller's Property into a single “zoning lot,” as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution (such single zoning lot being herein referred to as the “Combined Zoning Lot") B: \ny-srv01\SHAPIROS\934006v01\K0_M01!.DOC\12/24/03\24922.011000 1284 Lb 1- 3 Easf 4zhdsf

E. As used herein the “Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean certain rights, as determined by the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, whereby such zoning lot may be developed by erecting thereon one or more structures with floor area determined by multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the allowable floor area ratio (as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution) in that zoning district (as such term is defined in the ZoningResolution). F.As used herein the “Excess Development Rights” shall mean all of the Floor Area Development Rights that are appurtenant on the date hereof to the zoning lot in which the Seller's Property is located in excess of the floor area utilized by Seller's Building on the datehereof. G.The parties hereto have been advised that on the date hereof Seller's Building uses less than the maximum Floor Area Development Rights that are permitted for development on Seller's Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and that, therefore, Seller has available the Excess Development Rights that,under procedures currently available under the Zoning Resolution, may be made available to permit the construction of Developer's Proposed Building with floor area greater than that which would be permitted if the Excess Development Rights, or any portion thereof, were not so made available. H. Seller wishes to sell to Developer, and Developer wishes to purchase district in an amount equal to 9,400 square feet (the “Purchased Excess Development Rights") in order that Developer's Proposed Building be permitted to have floor area greater than that which would be permitted if the Purchased Excess Development Rights were not so made Development Rights; it being expressly understood that Seller is reserving for its own use the balance of the Excess Development Rights not purchased by Developer (the "Balance") to be utilized, at Seller's option, for a further expansion of Seller's Building.  I. The parties hereto, among others, have executed and delivered a certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration").dated the date hereof, which is intended to be submitted contemporaneously herewith forrecording in the New York County Office of the Register of the City of New York with respect to the Combined Zoning Lot.  J.Seller's Land is contiguous with Developer's Land for at least ten (10) linear feet, and Seller's Land and Developer's Land are all within a single block.
